collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HONESTY AND ACCOUNTABILITY (HON-01 to HON-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Small lies, kind fibs, things left unsaid, things forgotten, honest mistakes and the odd careless one. Consequences stay the size of the mistake. Privacy is not lying, truth doesn't automatically fix things, and nobody has to confess, apologize or forgive.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and a child aged 4-8)

collection.description: A villager told a child the moon follows them because it likes them, and other children are upset: explain, or say it likes all.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Walking home in the dark last week, (friend) asked (subject) why the moon kept following them. (subject), tired and keen to get home, said, "Because it likes you." Since then, (friend) has told every child in the village that the moon follows (friend.him/her) personally, because it likes (friend.him/her) best, and the other children are starting to be quite upset about it.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) gathers the children and explains that the moon is so far away that it seems to follow everybody at once. Each child tests it, running back and forth along the beach. It follows every one of them. The children are thrilled. (friend) is a little disappointed, then announces that the moon likes everybody the same, which seems fair.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "The moon likes all of you," (subject) tells them. "It follows everybody." The children test this, running in all directions in the dark, shouting, "It's following ME!" It's chaos. It's wonderful. (subject) walks home very slowly that night, followed by the moon and eleven children.
